OpenMAIC-Classroom v1.0.0

- Initial release of the interactive classroom lesson design skill.
- Transforms teaching topics, materials, or objectives into structured, interactive lesson plans.
- Features include tiered syllabus, slides, interactive activities, formative quizzes, AI teacher & peer roles, and follow-up practice—all deliverable in Chinese by default.
- Designed for flexible lesson planning: supports user-provided materials, differentiated instruction, and various activity types.
- Strict boundaries set for user privacy, content safety, and responsible tool usage.
- Outputs human- and machine-readable lesson packages, with validation tool for lesson JSON.
